speaker: Doctor

speaker: Doctor
text: Bilious vomiting in a newborn is a surgical emergency until proven otherwise, strongly suggesting intestinal obstruction. I need to visualize the anatomy immediately to rule out malrotation or atresia. REQUEST TEST: Abdominal Ultrasound

speaker: Doctor

speaker: Doctor
text: A normal upper GI series effectively rules out malrotation with volvulus. Given the persistent bilious vomiting and feeding intolerance, I need to evaluate for a midgut obstruction such as duodenal atresia. REQUEST TEST: Abdominal X-Ray
